strings: r_c asked m_c if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could use some help getting to know the other Clan members.
r_c offered herb lessons to m_c in case {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/weren't/wasn't} familiar with the more dangerous plants in the territory.
r_c introduced {PRONOUN/r_c/self} as c_n's medicine cat and asked m_c to let {PRONOUN/r_c/object} know if m_c ever feels ill.
